collection.title: Fiat Marea 1996 to 2002 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Fiat Marea Saloon 1996 to 2002 model requires a 23" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. There is the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
